description_en: Resumes video playback in a voice call after it has been paused
description_zh: 在语音通话中暂停视频播放后，恢复视频播放
name: ResumeVideoFile

parameters.description_en: The call ID. You can get the CallId from the response parameters of the [SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) API.
parameters.description_zh: 通话ID。您可以在[SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId。
parameters.help_en: The call ID. You can get the CallId from the response parameters of the [SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) API
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID。您可以在[SingleCallByVideo](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId

parameters.description_en: The mobile phone number for which to resume video playback.
